description: This file defines a validation rule class 'ProvinceCode' for validating province codes within the OrangeHRM system. It extends an abstract rule and utilizes services to fetch and validate province entities based on provided input.

classes.name: ProvinceCode
classes.description: A validation rule class used to verify if a given input corresponds to a valid province code by consulting the CountryService and entity Province.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates whether the input string corresponds to an existing Province via the CountryService.
